comparison.objective: Candidate fractures four insert tangs; record rotates a T-head bracket out of a keyed housing and separates the parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires impact regulation and tiny-fragment collection; record requires housing stabilization, roughly 80-degree keyed rotation, and axial withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires clean fractures, retained inserts, and contained fragments; record requires both disengaged parts held apart above marked outlines.
comparison.reason: Keyed rotational disengagement is not impact-induced sacrificial-feature fracture.
